subject.title: Feature Request: Add Skill Priority Configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill priority/ordering contract, and should it live in canonical `openclaw.json` skills config instead of a separate sidecar file?
rationale: The request changes model-facing session context, public config schema, CLI behavior, prompt-cache stability, and truncation behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Canonical Priority Config
options.body: Add a narrow ordering contract under the existing skills config/schema/docs and apply it only after existing eligibility and agent filters resolve.

options.title: Handle Only Truncation Visibility
options.body: Keep explicit priority out of core for now and let omitted-skill discovery or truncation recovery work address the immediate hidden-skill problem.

options.title: Fold Into Smart Skill Indexing
options.body: Defer this issue into a broader skill-search or lazy-loading design such as the category-aware indexing track.

recommendation.title: Add Canonical Priority Config
recommendation.body: Add a narrow ordering contract under the existing skills config/schema/docs and apply it only after existing eligibility and agent filters resolve.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current skills CLI/config history and commit metadata on adjacent prompt ordering and limit changes.
